title: New lower bounds for binary constant-weight codes from prescribed-automorphism search, and two quantum codes meeting their upper bounds
summary: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on $A(n,6,w)$ in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$,…
